executive_finding: Role-sensitive L0/L1/L2 Working Sets are the correct route, but /wc still contains an operational ambiguity: MASS LAUNCH says load minimum authoritative L0 and claim quickly, while LOAD FIRST enumerates broad meta-context before role specialization. Individual runs already demonstrate narrower receipts, and Context Fabric Lite P1 now exists as a tested candidate, but live automated role-conditioned selection remains unproven. The next step is not more context prose; it is a live pinned-repository canary that compares pre-claim minimum context against role-expanded context and measures correctness plus reduction.

evidence.finding: MASS LAUNCH FAST PATH requires minimum authoritative L0 and fast claim, but LOAD FIRST lists stable entry, constitution, Continuity/FOCUS, worker model, stale protocol, multi-surface plan, three meta-control documents, and conditional Master Context/portfolio. This leaves two plausible implementations: minimal pre-claim or broad pre-claim.
The model explicitly supports role/task-specific L1/L2 and bounded Working Sets for narrow implementation, so broad loading is not a cognitive requirement.

A successful narrow recovery persisted a structured receipt with L0, L1, exact L2, omitted refs, freshness, authority, contradictions and a narrow budget. This is concrete evidence that bounded context can retain critical laws.

A strategic integration run reached STARTED without a full structured context receipt and then went silent. This does not prove context caused the stall, but it proves receipt enforcement is not uniform even on a high-risk integration role.

The prior canary explicitly states that a manually assembled receipt does not prove Context Fabric, defines hard recall/staleness/contradiction gates, and lacked a repository-wide efficiency denominator.

Context Fabric Lite P1 passed 12/12 candidate tests and emits auditable automated receipts, but its own truth boundary says live full-repository efficiency and operational promotion remain unproven; its next boundary already calls for an independent pinned live-repository canary.

At activation time Continuity/FOCUS still described /wc v3.1 while the live bootstrap was v3.3. Stale summaries are useful pointers but unsafe as current-state authority unless the context layer surfaces the contradiction and refreshes live frontier evidence.

under_context_failure_modes: Using stale Continuity/FOCUS wording as current truth can allocate against an obsolete frontier or bootstrap version.
Strategic/integration roles without enforced Master Context + User Intent + Non-Regression + Verification receipts can silently shrink the north star or treat candidate evidence as operational.
A syntactically present receipt built by the worker itself can mask missing critical sources unless an independent gold/evaluator checks recall and freshness.
Omitting contradiction evidence can make newest-looking state appear authoritative even when projection lag or stale manual heads are known.
over_context_failure_modes: Loading all broad meta-docs before a worker knows its role increases activation latency and tool traffic for narrow EXECUTE/RECOVER work.
Scanning all queues/claims/runs/returns as raw files does not scale with 50 workers; workers need a compact derived frontier plus exact drill-down, not universal full-state reads.
Repeated broad context fetches increase exposure to mutually stale snapshots and make the worker spend cognition reconciling irrelevant domains.
Context volume without explicit omitted-set reasoning can still be bloated while looking rigorous.

keep: Constitution and authority laws as mandatory hard closure.
Receipts with omissions, hashes, freshness, authority and contradictions.
Context Fabric Lite P1 as the implementation candidate; do not build a competing context subsystem.
change: Make the two-stage load contract explicit: PRECLAIM_MIN then ROLE_EXPAND after claim/role selection.

PRECLAIM_MIN should contain only stable entry/constitution, live bootstrap law, current frontier projection or bounded queue metadata, authority/freshness pins, and exact evidence needed for allocation/recovery safety.

ROLE_EXPAND must be profile-driven: strategic/planner/critic/integrate/discovery gets Master Context + intent/non-regression/verification; narrow execute/recover gets task dependencies + target exact sources while retaining hard L0 laws.

Require every material run to persist selection_provenance and a structured receipt before substantive work; missing receipt on strategic/integration work is a hard verification failure, not a soft documentation gap.
Prefer compiled frontier/control-room projections to raw all-queue/all-run scans, with exact drill-down only for selected candidates and collision checks.

deduplicated_next_work.mission: Run Context Fabric Lite P1 against a pinned live repository/index and compare PRECLAIM_MIN plus at least three ROLE_EXPAND profiles (narrow RECOVER/EXECUTE, VERIFY/CRITIQUE, INTEGRATE/PLAN). Independently evaluate critical-source recall, authority/contradiction recall, stale-ref count, selected files/tokens versus scan denominator, and activation/tool-call reduction.
